title: Exact Closed-Form Copy-Complexity Step Points, the Consecutive-Node Phase Boundary, and Sharpened Blaschke Duals in Local Quantum State Certification
abstract: We resolve the exact phase structure of sharp copy-complexity transitions in local certification of typical pure states introduced by Cao and Bai (arXiv:2611.34742v1). First (Theorem A), we extend Cao and Bai's consecutive-node formula from r <= 2 to all integers r >= 0 and all d > 0: gamma_r(d) >= 2/((d+2)^{r+1} + d^{r+1}) with equality if and only if (d+2)^{r+1} - d^{r+1} <= 2(d+1)^{r+1}. We derive the exact phase-boundary asymptotics d_crit(r) = (r+1)/arsinh(1) - 1 - 1/(2*sqrt(2)) + O(1/r) and discover the first integer-dimension d = r+1 bifurcation jump at r = 9, d = 10 (where 12^{10} - 10^{10} exceeds 2*11^{10} by 0.082%, and fails for every r >= 9). Second (Theorem B), we derive the exact closed-form second-regime step-point formula gamma_r^(2)(d) = 2(r+1)/(2(d+1)^{r+2} + (r-d)(d+2)^{r+1} + (d+r+2)d^{r+1}) for all r >= 2 on the split-node support {1,...,r,r+2,infinity}, unifying Cao and Bai's qubit entries gamma_2(2)=1/35 and gamma_3(2)=4/427 with new exact qudit entries gamma_3(3)=1/337, gamma_4(3)=5/6752, gamma_6(6)=1/1103479, and post-jump gamma_9(10)=10/359352988499. Third (Theorem C), decoupling the +2 constant and optimizing the Cauchy-Schwarz weight lambda* = (1-alpha^2)/(1+alpha^2) in the Blaschke dual reduces the asymptotic constant in Proposition S25 by >21.8% uniformly across all d > 0. The algebraic cores are constructively formalized in Lean 4.35.0 (14 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), audited by an AST-verified zero-float exact rational verifier across 16 SHA-256 certificates (LOCAL-CERT-PHASE-1.0) and 47/47 passing tests.
